title: GTWS Channel (GT TV) — Live Races
claims: The GTWS Channel page has a 'Live Races' tab and lists the 2026 series races as live sessions, including Zegama-Aizkorri on 17/05/2026 and Sierre-Zinal on 08/08/2026.
On the access date the same page displayed 'There is no live event happening at the moment.'

verification.note: 2026-11-08 抓取 GTWS 官方 GT TV 页面，看到 Live Races 栏、2026 各站列表（含 ZEGAMA-AIZKORRI 17/05/2026）与「There is no live event happening at the moment.」提示。该页未给出 2027 的直播平台、语言或场次。

claimVerification.note: Live Races 选项卡下列出 2026 年各站：MUJU TRAIL GRAND FINALE 24/10/2026、JINSHANLING 27/09/2026、MYOKO 20/09/2026、SIERRE-ZINAL 08/08/2026、PITZ ALPINE 01/08/2026、QUÉBEC 05/07/2026、LEDRO SKY 24/05/2026、ZEGAMA-AIZKORRI 17/05/2026。
'There is no live event happening at the moment.'
